summary: John's 2nd-great-grand-uncle; Dr. Andrew J. Heffernan Jr., Wilkes-Barre dentist who built the Heffernan Building.
bio: Dr. Andrew Joseph Heffernan (27 Feb 1881 - 17 Nov 1959) attended Wyoming Seminary and took a DDS from Philadelphia Dental College (Temple) in 1907. He was president of the Susquehanna Dental Society, State Grand Master of Psi Omega, built the Heffernan Building in Wilkes-Barre, practiced dentistry more than 50 years and served 19 years on the state dental board. He married Lillian T. MacDonald, daughter of a director of Philadelphia's Corn Exchange National Bank; their Philadelphia marriage application of 24 Nov 1914 names his father Andrew H. Heffernan (b. Ireland, clerk) and mother Mary Connole (b. New York).
